rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Config {
    meta:
        description = "Detects configuration block within Cobalt Strike Beacon payloads"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 6e 61 6d 65 2e 63 6f 6d } // ".rcdname.com"
        $b = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" fullword ascii
        $c = "Accept: */*" fullword ascii
        $d = { 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 [4-10] 00 00 00 00 } // Common config structure
    condition:
        all of them
}

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs via characteristic strings and sections"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        maltype = "backdoor"
    strings:
        $s1 = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $s2 = "SetSessionKey" fullword ascii
        $s3 = "CryptoEncrypt" fullword ascii
        $s4 = "HttpSendRequest" fullword ascii
        $s5 = ".bss" fullword ascii
        $s6 = ".data" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of ($s1, $s2, $s3, $s4) and 2 of ($s5, $s6)
}
